description: Seed-ready product type master data for a pharmacy platform.

productTypes.name: Medicine
productTypes.description: Prescription and over-the-counter medicines used for treating, preventing, or managing illness and disease.

productTypes.name: Supplement
productTypes.description: Vitamins, minerals, amino acids, herbal extracts, and other dietary supplements intended to support health.

productTypes.name: Medical Device
productTypes.description: Medical instruments, equipment, and devices such as blood pressure monitors, glucometers, and thermometers.

productTypes.name: Surgical Item
productTypes.description: Disposable and reusable surgical and clinical-use items such as syringes, gloves, bandages, and gauze.

productTypes.name: Personal Care
productTypes.description: Personal hygiene and grooming products including soaps, shampoos, deodorants, and dental care items.

productTypes.name: Cosmetic
productTypes.description: Beauty and cosmetic products including skincare, makeup, fragrances, and topical beauty treatments.

productTypes.name: Baby Care
productTypes.description: Products designed for infant and toddler care including diapers, baby wipes, baby food, and baby skincare.

productTypes.name: FMCG
productTypes.description: Fast-moving consumer goods including everyday household and hygiene products sold at low cost and high volume.

productTypes.name: Food & Beverage
productTypes.description: Packaged food, nutritional drinks, juices, and health beverages available in pharmacy retail.

productTypes.name: Herbal & Unani
productTypes.description: Traditional herbal, unani, and natural medicine products used for holistic and alternative healthcare.

productTypes.name: Other
productTypes.description: Miscellaneous retail products that do not fall under any other product type category.
